provider: Connect Trade broker-sourced realtime market-data API/MCP
evidence: Connect Trade officially exposes realtime Level 1 quotes, trades/time-and-sales, bars, depth and options chains over WebSocket and says the data is sourced directly from the user's connected broker.
Connect Trade states its broker integrations use official sanctioned APIs and are compliance approved; it also exposes a Remote MCP/API surface.
Market data carries no additional Connect Trade licensing fee only when the user is already authorized for that data at the connected broker; therefore upstream entitlement conditions still apply.
Production Builder access is $19/month and includes only a 7-day free trial. Growth/Enterprise are also paid.

Consequently strict permanent-$0 gate C fails both at the Connect Trade platform layer and potentially at the underlying broker entitlement layer, even though D and the technical B surface are strong.

gate_analysis.A: DEPENDS_ON_CONNECTED_BROKER; cannot infer National NBBO lineage generically

reopen_condition: Connect Trade must offer permanent-$0 production access and a connected broker must independently grant this exact consolidated National-NBBO quote+trade automated/non-display entitlement permanently at $0 with no balance/funding/activity/subscription/per-query/account-maintenance condition.
